name: lb_id
description: The ID and ARN of the load balancer we created.

name: lb_arn
description: The ID and ARN of the load balancer we created.

name: lb_arn_suffix
description: ARN suffix of our load balancer - can be used with CloudWatch.

name: https_listener_arns
description: The ARNs of the HTTPS load balancer listeners created.

name: https_listener_ids
description: The IDs of the load balancer listeners created.

name: target_group_arns
description: ARNs of the target groups. Useful for passing to your Auto Scaling group.

name: target_group_arn_suffixes
description: ARN suffixes of our target groups - can be used with CloudWatch.

name: target_group_names
description: Name of the target group. Useful for passing to your CodeDeploy Deployment Group.

name: lb_dns_name
description: The DNS name of the load balancer.

name: lb_zone_id
description: The zone_id of the load balancer to assist with creating DNS records.

name: http_tcp_listener_arns
description: The ARN of the TCP and HTTP load balancer listeners created.

name: http_tcp_listener_ids
description: The IDs of the TCP and HTTP load balancer listeners created.

name: target_group_attachments
description: ARNs of the target group attachment IDs.
